notes.title: Demo Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone. It’s been a week since we released the demo, and we’ve gone through all your feedback and tried to fix as many issues as we could. But before we get to the list of changes, we want to say a few words.



First of all, we’re thrilled by your response! Thank you for the support and for believing in the project. We promise it’s only going to get better from here.



Second, along with bug reports, you’ve shared a lot of great ideas to improve the game overall. Some of them have already made it into this update. Others will take more time, so we’ve postponed them until release. Please keep sharing your thoughts in the comments — we read and note down everything.



Now on to the update:

You can now skip through dialogue using the spacebar

Added the option to turn off mouse click sounds

Added the option to turn off the typing sound

You can now switch between windowed and fullscreen modes

Fixed sound issues, like birds randomly chirping outside the grocery store

General sound tweaks and improvements

Fixed a bug where text formatting broke at larger font sizes

Minor improvements to text for better readability

Missing Steam icons added

A bunch of bugs fixed

Added a "Wishlist" button to the main menu



Huge thanks to everyone who has already played the demo. If you haven’t tried it yet, we’d love for you to check it out.



See you soon,

Dima and Max
